Chapter 02

Morning Mist

Mist takes the low streets.Glass first.Then rails.Wet paint.Black wire.At one cornera painter stops walking.Across the streeta crow turns its head.Three blocks latera radio loses a songhalfway through.A door openswhere nobody was waiting.A chair is carried downstairs.The same mistpasses both places.Nothing written in it.Nothing spoken.Still,everyone seemsto have heard something.Stopped under a poleuntil the mist moved on.The wire kept humming.

Terminal City · Storybook v0.14.0 · built 2026-10-15
Terminal City is an original fictional mythology inspired by Vancouver’s geography, weather, wildlife, infrastructure, art and electronic music. It makes no claim to historical, Indigenous or religious tradition. Real places are used as settings; the hidden system layered across them is invented.
Made by Steve Hiehn, a software developer and electronic musician based in Vancouver, Canada. All music was created using a custom DAW, Signals & Sorcery.
Video footage: "Foggy day of hyrcanian forest of iran" by Reza Rafizadeh (CC BY 3.0) · "Vancouver at Twilight" by Vidaerc (CC BY 3.0). Public-domain archive film and photographs, and licensed stock.
